Reading notes for Itqan: the "Initial Response" greeting and "report before fixing / stop" rules apply when the skill is used on its own. In Itqan's Acceptance stage the worst-case pass runs non-interactively: map the fields, build the worst-case data through the app's real API or seed path, check the failure signatures at the stated widths, then fix every Broken and Ugly finding in the build before the report and list the rest. The dev-only toggle is optional; worst-case data can be seeded into a scratch database instead.
